name: adapt
label: ADAPT (Agriculture)
description: Agricultural Data Application Programming Toolkit — precision farming
short_description: Agricultural Data Application Programming Toolkit — precision farming
long_description: ADAPT (Agricultural Data Application Programming Toolkit) is the multi-vendor standard from John Deere, AGCO, CNH Industrial, and Trimble for farm data exchange. The schema covers the complete precision agriculture data chain: farm and field boundaries, crop zone planting records, field operations (planting, spraying, harvest), machine registrations, agricultural inputs, GPS time logs, and harvest yield data.
when_to_use: Use for precision agriculture platforms, farm management information systems (FMIS), agtech apps, or any agricultural data integration. ADAPT is implemented by all major precision agriculture equipment manufacturers. Required for John Deere Operations Center and Climate FieldView integrations. Essential for carbon credit programs that need verified field activity data.

table_notes.adapt_farm: Top-level entity representing a farming enterprise; holds ownership, country, and full outer boundary polygon.
table_notes.adapt_field: A named parcel of arable land within a farm, with measured area, soil classification, and irrigation method.
table_notes.adapt_crop_zone: A sub-field planting unit for a specific crop variety and season, bounded by a polygon within adapt_field.
table_notes.adapt_operation: A single timed field activity (planting, spraying, harvesting) linking a field, crop zone, machine, and operator.
table_notes.adapt_machine: Registry of farm equipment with manufacturer details, machine category, and working width for coverage calculations.
table_notes.adapt_ag_input: Catalogue of agricultural inputs (seeds, fertilisers, pesticides) with regulatory registration and physical properties.
table_notes.adapt_time_log: High-frequency GPS telemetry log generated by in-cab controllers; one row per second of machine operation.
table_notes.adapt_harvest: Per-crop-zone harvest summary with area, moisture-adjusted and wet yields used for yield mapping and carbon reporting.

adapt_farm.name: id
adapt_farm.description: Universally unique identifier for the farm record

adapt_farm.name: name
adapt_farm.description: Human-readable name of the farm as used by the operator

adapt_farm.name: description
adapt_farm.description: Free-text notes about the farm (history, terrain, special conditions)

adapt_farm.name: owner_id
adapt_farm.description: References the application user or organisation that owns this farm

adapt_farm.name: country
adapt_farm.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code where the farm is located

adapt_farm.name: boundary
adapt_farm.description: Outer boundary of the entire farm as a WGS84 polygon for spatial queries

adapt_field.name: id
adapt_field.description: Universally unique identifier for the field record

adapt_field.name: farm_id
adapt_field.description: References adapt_farm; links this field to its parent farm

adapt_field.name: name
adapt_field.description: Operator-assigned name for the field (e.g. 'North 40', 'River Block')

adapt_field.name: area_hectares
adapt_field.description: Measured area of the field in hectares (used for rate and yield calculations)

adapt_field.name: boundary
adapt_field.description: Field perimeter as a WGS84 polygon; source of truth for area and containment checks

adapt_field.name: soil_type
adapt_field.description: Dominant soil classification (e.g. 'Sandy loam', 'Clay', 'Silt') for input recommendations

adapt_field.name: irrigation_type
adapt_field.description: Primary irrigation method (e.g. 'drip', 'pivot', 'flood', 'rainfed') affecting water management

adapt_crop_zone.name: id
adapt_crop_zone.description: Universally unique identifier for the crop zone record

adapt_crop_zone.name: field_id
adapt_crop_zone.description: References adapt_field; the parent field containing this crop zone

adapt_crop_zone.name: crop_species
adapt_crop_zone.description: Botanical or common species name of the crop planted (e.g. 'Zea mays', 'Wheat')

adapt_crop_zone.name: variety
adapt_crop_zone.description: Cultivar or hybrid name as labelled by the seed supplier

adapt_crop_zone.name: planting_date
adapt_crop_zone.description: Calendar date the crop was seeded or transplanted into the zone

adapt_crop_zone.name: harvest_date
adapt_crop_zone.description: Actual or planned harvest date; NULL while crop is still growing

adapt_crop_zone.name: year
adapt_crop_zone.description: Crop year / growing season (e.g. 2024) for multi-year rotation queries

adapt_crop_zone.name: boundary
adapt_crop_zone.description: Polygon of the planted zone within the field; may differ from field boundary for rotations

adapt_operation.name: id
adapt_operation.description: Universally unique identifier for the operation record

adapt_operation.name: field_id
adapt_operation.description: References adapt_field; the field where the operation was performed

adapt_operation.name: crop_zone_id
adapt_operation.description: References adapt_crop_zone; crop context for the operation (nullable for non-crop work)

adapt_operation.name: start_time
adapt_operation.description: UTC timestamp when the machine began work on this operation

adapt_operation.name: end_time
adapt_operation.description: UTC timestamp when the machine completed work; NULL for in-progress operations

adapt_operation.name: operator_id
adapt_operation.description: References the application user who drove or supervised this operation

adapt_operation.name: machine_id
adapt_operation.description: References adapt_machine; the primary equipment unit used for this operation

adapt_operation.name: notes
adapt_operation.description: Operator free-text observations (weather, anomalies, skipped areas)

adapt_machine.name: id
adapt_machine.description: Universally unique identifier for the machine record

adapt_machine.name: serial_number
adapt_machine.description: Manufacturer serial number; unique per machine for warranty and compliance tracking

adapt_machine.name: year
adapt_machine.description: Model year of manufacture; used for depreciation and telematics capability checks

adapt_machine.name: width_meters
adapt_machine.description: Working width in metres; used to calculate covered area from GPS track length

adapt_ag_input.name: id
adapt_ag_input.description: Auto-incremented surrogate key for the agricultural input product

adapt_ag_input.name: name
adapt_ag_input.description: Commercial product name as printed on the label (e.g. 'Roundup PowerMAX')

adapt_ag_input.name: manufacturer
adapt_ag_input.description: Company that manufactures or distributes this product

adapt_ag_input.name: registration_number
adapt_ag_input.description: Regulatory registration code issued by the national pesticide or fertiliser authority

adapt_ag_input.name: density
adapt_ag_input.description: Product density in kg/L; used to convert between volume and mass application rates

adapt_ag_input.name: uom
adapt_ag_input.description: Default unit of measure for application rate (e.g. 'kg/ha', 'L/ha', 'seeds/ha')

adapt_ag_input.name: active_ingredients
adapt_ag_input.description: Array of {name, cas_number, concentration_pct} objects listing active chemical components

adapt_time_log.name: id
adapt_time_log.description: Auto-incremented surrogate key; high-volume table expects billions of rows

adapt_time_log.name: operation_id
adapt_time_log.description: References adapt_operation; groups all GPS ticks belonging to one field operation

adapt_time_log.name: timestamp
adapt_time_log.description: UTC timestamp of the GPS fix; typically 1-second resolution from ISOBUS controller

adapt_time_log.name: location
adapt_time_log.description: Machine centroid position as WGS84 point; basis for coverage map rasterisation

adapt_time_log.name: heading_degrees
adapt_time_log.description: Machine heading in degrees clockwise from true north (0–359.99)

adapt_time_log.name: speed_kmh
adapt_time_log.description: Ground speed in km/h; used to flag stopped periods and compute application totals

adapt_time_log.name: section_states
adapt_time_log.description: Object mapping section index to boolean; e.g. {"0":true,"1":false} for boom section on/off states

adapt_time_log.name: applied_rate
adapt_time_log.description: Actual application rate recorded by the controller at this point (value in applied_uom units)

adapt_time_log.name: applied_uom
adapt_time_log.description: Unit of measure for applied_rate (e.g. 'L/ha', 'kg/ha'); matches adapt_ag_input.uom

adapt_harvest.name: id
adapt_harvest.description: Universally unique identifier for the harvest summary record

adapt_harvest.name: crop_zone_id
adapt_harvest.description: References adapt_crop_zone; the planted area this harvest summary covers

adapt_harvest.name: harvest_date
adapt_harvest.description: Calendar date the harvest was completed or the summary was recorded

adapt_harvest.name: area_harvested_ha
adapt_harvest.description: Actual area harvested in hectares (may differ from crop zone area due to losses or partial harvest)

adapt_harvest.name: moisture_pct
adapt_harvest.description: Grain moisture percentage at time of harvest; used to compute dry yield

adapt_harvest.name: yield_dry_kg_ha
adapt_harvest.description: Yield normalised to 0% moisture in kg/ha; standard metric for agronomic comparison

adapt_harvest.name: yield_wet_kg_ha
adapt_harvest.description: As-harvested wet yield in kg/ha before drying adjustment

adapt_harvest.name: quality_data
adapt_harvest.description: Flexible object for crop-specific quality metrics: {protein_pct, test_weight, oil_pct, starch_pct, etc.}
